The constant-input geometric formula and strict threshold tests prove event-skipping termination, including equality asymptotes. All rational example claims verified independently by a pure-Python rational checker.

value.rationale: A relevant source expressly identifies multi-action cascades as only sufficient. The new necessary-and-sufficient all-profile criterion determines *which* agents are guaranteed to adopt and the exact slowest possible time. Its finite-event bound avoids huge per-time-step simulations in stiff inertia regimes, and its four-action rational case demonstrates a real gap between a scalar sufficient criterion and exact recovery. This is a complete natural algorithmic classification, not a cosmetic extra case.
